GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-07-25T21:06:32Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: How to prevent crash on unhandled errors when using streams?
Description: Hi,

what is the recommended way of preventing a crash of the application if I'm using sharp as follows and the buffer data is undefined or has unsupported image data in it?
The 'error' event is not being fired in this case. Do I need to incorporate a try/catch block somehow?

``` js
var pipeline = sharp()
.on('error', err => console.log('error'))
.pipe(fs.createWriteStream('filename.jpg'));

var readStream = new stream.PassThrough();
readStream.end(someBuffer);

readStream.pipe(pipeline);
```

When `someBuffer` is undefined, I get this error and the app crashes.

```
     Error: Input file is missing or of an unsupported image format
        at Error (native)
```
